units.text: Both sources confirm the IMAP launch occurred on September 24, 2025, from Kennedy Space Center in Florida.

judgement.reason: The NASA SVS passage states the mission launched on Sept. 24, 2025, from NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida, and the PMC passage confirms the September 24, 2025 launch from Launch Complex 39A at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center.
